items.source: Get the parts the field name consists of. If the FieldName is a FieldName.Type.KEY or a FieldName.Type.PATH that does not contain dot (.) characters an array containing a single element is returned. Otherwise the name() is split into segments using dot (.) as a separator.
items.translation: 获取字段名组成部分。如果 FieldName 是 FieldName.Type.KEY，或者是一个不包含点号（.）字符的 FieldName.Type.PATH，则返回包含单个元素的数组。否则，使用点号（.）作为分隔符将 name() 拆分为多个段。

items.source: Value Object representing a field name that should be used to read/write fields within the MongoDB document. Field names field names may contain special characters (such as dot (.)) but may be treated differently depending on their type.
items.translation: 表示应在 MongoDB 文档中用于读写字段的字段名的值对象。 Field names 字段名可以包含特殊字符（例如点号 (.)），但会根据其 type 受到不同的处理。

items.source: The type defines how to treat a FieldName that contains special characters.
items.translation: type 定义了如何处理包含特殊字符的 FieldName。

items.source: Create a new FieldName that treats the given value as a path.

items.source: Create a new FieldName that treats the given value as a path. If the value contains dot (.) characters, they are considered deliminators in a path.
items.translation: 创建一个新的FieldName，将给定值视为路径。如果该值包含点（.）字符，则这些字符被视为路径中的分隔符。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。
